lessons_used: Moving sign-in post-adoption (+13.3%, underpredicted) or post-certificate (+5.8%, overpredicted) and multi-device account sync banners (+2.7%, overpredicted) were helpful, while post-waiting room sign-in hurt (-3.9%) and other sync hints showed no clear effect.

Path clarity headline updates (+5.9%, underpredicted) and path selection spotlight layouts (+2.7%, underpredicted) were helpful; copy simplifications, value refreshes, time expectation banners, and showcase layouts showed no clear effect.

Interactive waiting rooms (+5.6%, overpredicted), background readiness status (+3.3%, underpredicted), and desktop visibility status checks (+4.7%, underpredicted) were helpful, whereas 3D trackers, completion timer displays, sound notifications, and spawn alerts showed no clear effect.

lessons_next: Moving sign-in to post-adoption (+13.3%) or post-certificate (+5.8%), adding account recovery copy (+4.2%), and multi-device sync banners (+2.7%) were helpful; post-waiting room sign-in hurt (-3.9%), while other sync hints had no clear effect.

Interactive waiting rooms (+5.6%), background readiness status (+3.3%), visibility status checks (+4.7%), and spawn location hints (+4.5%) were helpful; 3D trackers, completion timers, sound notifications, and spawn alerts showed no clear effect.

Companion previews paired with photo quality guides (+7.6%) or split upload layouts (+8.1%) were helpful; compact grid layouts (-7.7%), photo fallback flows (-11.8%), guidelines banners (-5.0%), and mascot stamp redesigns (-24.1%) hurt results.

System tray location tips (+3.8%) were helpful, whereas direct controls guides (-14.4%) and first interaction tips (-6.5%) made results worse; mascot welcome stages, interaction badges, tray controls tips, and docking hints showed no clear effect.

Predictions overpredicted severe negative impacts (such as mascot stamp redesigns and direct controls guides) while underpredicting large wins from headline updates, visual redesigns, and companion preview layouts.
